baselinePolicy: Hooks run through Xenon's instruction-hook contract (hint kind "instruction"), implemented in revisions/usa-retail-tu0/hooks/. Only base-executable fixes - changes the official title update makes, which this base executable lacks - are enabled. Optional enhancements and research probes stay disabled metadata.

hooks.name: ac6StorageOrderHookOp2
hooks.rationale: The retail title update stores each storage job's operation code to [job+4] before JobPoolB::Submit; this base executable stores it after, so a fast pool-B worker can run a reused job with the previous operation. The hook applies the title update's ordering at this call site.
